column1: #mapping_set_description: This file contains the mappings between the Chemical Methods
#  Ontology (CHMO) and REX. These mappings were manually created/curated by Ambika
#  Gupta and reviewed by Philip Strömert & Colin Batchelor. The intended use case of
#  this mapping set is the data integration of RDF knowledge graphs (KGs) that use
#  Wikidata and are to be transformed into RDF KGs that use CHMO or vice versa.
